name: Indicators
description: State indicators: screen recording, night light, do not disturb, stay awake, screensaver hold and the runtime context show while on; hovering reveals the others dimmed; a click toggles one. Entries another bar widget already shows (pager, idle, privacy) are left out. Its service, off until gameClasses is set, enters the game context for a fullscreen game

items.description: Which indicators to show, in order: ScreenRecording, NightLight, Dnd, StayAwake, Screensaver, Context; empty shows all. Context shows only while a context other than normal is active

alwaysShow.description: Show inactive indicators (dimmed) without waiting for hover

gameClasses.description: Window classes (JavaScript regular expressions, whole class) that enter the game context while fullscreen and focused, e.g. steam_app_\d+; empty = off. Set with haseen context auto-game
